mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report (reporter_id, target_type, target_id, reason, status, created_at) VALUES (#{reporterId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reason}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, reporter_id, target_type, target_id, reason, status, handler_id, handle_action, created_at, handled_at FROM report WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE report SET status = #{status}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, handle_action = #{handleAction}, handled_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
